drhp.business: Established in 2001 and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, where its manufacturing plant is also located, Goblin makes and sells travel gear - hard and soft luggage, backpacks, office and duffle bags, ladies' handbags and purses and travel accessories. It sells through a dealer network of over 525 dealers in India and over 300 in France, one Company-owned retail outlet in Ahmedabad, and B2B/B2C online channels. risks.note: MD&A 'Risks & Concerns' names cost volatility from global geopolitical upheavals as a key identified risk that could adversely affect performance, future growth and cash flow; the Company relies on its ERM framework and internal controls to mitigate it.
risks.risk: Input cost volatility driven by global geopolitical upheavals

risks.note: MD&A explicitly flags import-related currency fluctuations among key identified risks - the Company buys inputs abroad and also has an overseas (France) presence, so rupee moves feed directly into landed cost.

MD&A names intense market competition as a key identified risk; the same bundle describes D2C and online-first brands restructuring the competitive landscape on pricing, product responsiveness and service, and forcing traditional retail-dependent brands to respond.

Both the standalone and consolidated auditors qualified their opinion because the Company / Holding Company did not provide the GST electronic credit ledger, reconciliations and detailed GST payable workings, leaving the auditors unable to verify the related GST balances in the books of account.
risks.risk: Qualified audit opinion - GST records not made available for verification

risks.note: The auditors report outstanding statutory liabilities under the Income Tax Act, 1961, non-filing of the Income Tax Return for AY 2025-26 and of applicable TDS returns for FY 2025-26 within prescribed timelines, and TDS liabilities still unpaid as at 31 March 2026. Management made no provision for interest, penalty or other liabilities that may crystallise, and disclosed no related contingent liability, so the auditors could not determine the consequential impact on the financial statements.
risks.risk: Qualified audit opinion - unpaid and unprovided direct-tax liabilities

risks.note: Directors' Report states that for Goblin France SARL the Company must file an Annual Performance Report (APR) and Return of Foreign Liabilities and Assets (FLA) with the RBI by 31st December and 15th July each year, but the APR and Form FLA for the relevant period were not filed.
risks.risk: Non-compliance with FEMA filing obligations for the French subsidiary

risks.note: The Directors' Report records that, consequent to notice of a transaction (the underlying detail is not in the routed text), the Company initiated strict vigilance and an action plan requiring such information to be notified on a prior basis, indicating a lapse in prior intimation of that class of transaction.
risks.risk: Compliance and disclosure control over related transactions

risks.note: MD&A states the headquarters and manufacturing plant are both based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, so operations, output and the automated capacity are concentrated at one site.
risks.risk: Dependence on a single manufacturing and headquarters location
